title: Narrow LocationService's `on Object catch` clauses so programming errors aren't swallowed
why: `on Object` catches everything Dart can throw, including Error subtypes (TypeError, NoSuchMethodError, StateError, ...) that only_throw_errors-compliant code elsewhere in the app throws for genuine programming bugs. A plugin-level type mismatch or null-safety violation inside geolocator/geocoding would silently become 'location fetch failed' (or a silently-null country code) forever, with no crash report and no log line — exactly the bug-masking EH-4 exists to prevent.
recommendation: Change both clauses to `on Exception catch (e)` (or the specific exception types geolocator/geocoding document), letting Error subtypes propagate and reach Crashlytics/crash loudly.
acceptance_criteria: Both catch clauses in location_service.dart are typed to Exception (or narrower), not Object
A test asserts a thrown Error from the fake platform is NOT converted to LocationFetchError/null but propagates
